content.text:
**You're Invited to the Spring School Concert!**

Dear Families and Friends,

Please join us for an evening of music performed by the students of [School Name]. Our choir, orchestra, and solo performers have been practicing all term, and we would love to share their hard work with you.

**Date:** [Day, Month Date, Year]
**Time:** [Start Time] (doors open at [Door Time])
**Venue:** [School Name] Main Hall, [Address]

**Program highlights:**
- School Choir: spring selections
- Junior and Senior Orchestra
- Solo and ensemble performances from students across all grades

Admission is free, and all are welcome. Seating is available on a first-come basis, so we recommend arriving a little early. Light refreshments will be served in the lobby after the performance.

Please RSVP by [RSVP Date] to [Contact Name] at [Email or Phone Number] so we can plan seating.

We look forward to celebrating our students' talents with you.

Warm regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[School Name]
